translated: I'd love to see the ocean in Hokkaido too.
I think going by ferry is a great idea.
If you combine the flight and hotel costs, taking the ferry might even be a bit cheaper, so...
As long as you don't get seasick, I think it's perfect for people who love the ocean.
I've heard Oarai is nice too.
I really only just boarded the ferry there, but the air was so fresh.
It was only for a short time, but since it had just rained, there was a rainbow, and...
The sky was so clear and beautiful. I'd love to actually go sightseeing in Oarai next time.
There were definitely a lot of people heading that way, so... yeah.
I heard there are a lot of wonderful traditional inns there.
Ah, now there are even more places I want to visit.
It turns out we both have some proper summer memories after all.
